sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Indoor blower communication failure: the control cannot communicate with the blower motor.
causes: Lost communication with the indoor blower motor, including after a power outage
Problem on the control side or the motor side
diySteps: Turn the furnace off at the switch or breaker and confirm the furnace still has power when you turn it back on. A power outage is one cause the manual names
Technician: check motor power and wiring. The problem may be on the control or the motor. The code clears after the fault is recovered
proAdvice: E201 is a blower-communication fault, not a filter code and not E292 (blower unable to start). If the breaker is on and the code returns, call a licensed HVAC technician.
